article.title: Duck! A Call for Submissions
article.content: "Stormtroopers Advance Under a Gas Attack", Otto Dix, 1924. Debates & Interviews / DSA / History & Theory Submission Call: 9/19/2026 Submission Due Date: 10/15/2026 Contact and Submission Address: reformandrevolutiondsa@gmail.com Introduction Reform & Revolution’s (R&R) publication, Reform & Revolution , requests submissions to its 24 th issue, tentatively titled Duck! . Since the end of 2025, the periodical Geese – self-described as a ‘daily review of American Communism’ – has released articles and editorials spanning myriad practical and theoretical issues facing America’s left. In Geese’s July 9 th , 2026, piece “Towards Active Revolution: Where to Begin? The Permanent Campaign,” writer P.K. Gandakin implores interested activists to ‘start putting [your ideas] down on paper’; this issue seeks to meet Gandakin’s important call in a comradely fashion and utilize our space to disseminate peoples’ interaction with, responses to, and feelings about Geese’s political interventions. This call for papers is open to any writer interested in furthering debates and conversations around articles produced by, or associated with, Geese’s work. There is no restriction on tendency or viewpoint, provided the writer contributes in good faith and substantively provides an original analysis of ongoing issues within the electoral, organizational, labor, or associated leftwing sites of struggle. We also ask that comrades who submit pieces either include – or suggest! – a visual lead for their article. This could be a photo from an organizing event, a representative logo from your chapter, or anything that relates to the article in general. Scope This issue will publish several articles from our tendency, R&R, alongside those of other interested contributors. Provided the discussion is productive, polemics, supportive commentary, and anything in-between are welcome as submissions. A list of possible topics may include, but are not limited to, the following: Comments on, or responses to, Project 2029 Opinions on electoral – or abstentionist – strategy and Geese’s relationship to the same Your tendency’s interpretation and analysis of, or tasks related to, the arrival of a new popular socialist publication Responses to recent editorials or opinion pieces featured in Geese Political or theoretical criticism, support, or reimagining of popular Geese articles These examples are not exhaustive. Anything related to the general theme will be considered; comrades are encouraged to send a very brief abstract or summary of their article alongside the completed document, so that communication can be streamlined. If a comrade wishes to submit a pitch or idea prior to writing a full piece, they are welcome to do so. Editorial Policy While Reform & Revolution hopes to utilize this issue as a broad spectrum, inclusive space for DSA comrades’ conversations adjacent to Geese , the members of our magazine’s Editorial Board (EBoard) will have final say in publication and stylistic guidelines. Our magazine traditionally employs spirited and comradely political editing for our members’ contributions; however, this issue is meant to curate viewpoints that differ from our own. Still, we ask that interested parties submit their pieces with the understanding that our EBoard may request stylistic changes. While our editorial policy allows for personal variation and authorial voice, we retain the right to ask for minor corrections prior to publication.
